name: decide_refund
description: Deterministic refund policy: approve, deny or send to manual review, with a stable reason code.

order_id.description: Carried for traceability; the policy does not read it.

account_id.description: Carried for traceability; the policy does not read it.

order_state.description: delivered, shipped or returned can be refunded; anything else is denied; empty fails closed.

refunds_last_90d.description: Refunds already issued to this account in the last 90 days.

risk_flags.description: Fraud or risk signals. Omit or null when the risk lookup failed: the policy fails closed.

requires_approval.description: True exactly when the decision is manual_review.
